episodes.title: Epstein Survivor Condemns Vote Advancing Todd Blanche for Attorney General
episodes.description:
Jeffrey Epstein survivor Danielle Bensky has condemned the Senate Judiciary Committee’s decision to advance Todd Blanche’s nomination for US attorney general, calling the vote “incredibly depressing”.
